UPDATE sessions SET staffId = CASE 
  WHEN id % 4 = 0 THEN 150001
  WHEN id % 4 = 1 THEN 180001
  WHEN id % 4 = 2 THEN 180002
  ELSE 180003
END
WHERE staffId NOT IN (SELECT id FROM staff);
